Build the request URL ```text https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY ``` * Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual Google Maps API key. * The `latlng` parameter takes the latitude and longitude separated by a comma. * The response format is JSON (`json`). You can also request XML if you prefer. ### 2. Make the HTTP GET request You can use any HTTP client: | Tool | Example | |------|---------| | **cURL** | `curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY"` | | **Python (requests)** | ```python
import requests
url = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json"
params = {"latlng": "37.4224764,-122.0842499", "key": "YOUR_API_KEY"}
response = requests.get(url, params=params)
print(response.json())
``` | | **JavaScript (fetch)** | ```js
fetch("https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY")
.then(r => r.json())
.then(data => console.log(data));
``` | ### 3.
